name: Annelieke Vermeer
bio:
Annelieke Vermeer is a seasoned logistics coordinator with over 20 years of experience in motorsport. Her journey began unexpectedly, volunteering at a local karting track where her organizational skills quickly became apparent. She transitioned from organizing race events to managing complex logistics for smaller racing teams before joining Century Motorsport. 

Annelieke's pragmatic approach is her strength. She prides herself on anticipating problems before they arise and devising efficient, cost-effective solutions. Her meticulous planning and attention to detail ensure that the team's equipment and personnel are always where they need to be, when they need to be there, minimizing downtime and maximizing performance. What sets Annelieke apart is her ability to remain calm and focused under pressure, a quality highly valued within the high-stakes environment of professional racing.

physical.description: Annelieke is a woman of medium height with a practical, no-nonsense appearance.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool on her keychain.
Insists on using color-coded labels for everything.
Starts every morning with a cup of strong black coffee and a detailed review of the day's logistics.
